name: Chuck PWA — operator chat surface
description: Tailscale-served chat surface for the Chuck operator (iPad / iPhone / Mac PWA). Voice picker, transcript persistence, persona injection from IDENTITY.md, programmatic dispatch through @openclaw/skill-panel-ask. Replaces the standalone chuck-pwa-server.mjs by registering routes through the openclaw gateway.

routePrefix.label: HTTP route prefix
routePrefix.help: Prefix under which the plugin registers all routes. Default '/chuck-v3' preserves URL compatibility with the legacy chuck-pwa-server.

defaultVoice.label: Default voice
defaultVoice.help: Voice picked by the chat UI when no per-device localStorage value exists.

askTimeoutMs.label: Ask request timeout (ms)
askTimeoutMs.help: Hard ceiling for a single /api/chuck-v3/ask round-trip.

personaInjectsIdentity.label: Inject IDENTITY.md as persona
personaInjectsIdentity.help: When true, every /ask prepends the canonical IDENTITY.md plus recent memory-graph nodes. Disable to test raw model voices.

personaInjectsRecentMemory.label: Inject recent memory-graph context
personaInjectsRecentMemory.help: When true, the last N memory-graph nodes are included in the persona preamble.

personaRecentNodes.label: Number of recent memory-graph nodes
personaRecentNodes.help: Count of nodes pulled into the preamble. Higher = more continuity, more prompt budget.
